title: On Belonging to the old families
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：belong　|　正文 332 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 belong 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 the herder ① belonged to the old families twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the herder ② belongs to the old families year after year without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ belong to the old families at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ belonged to the old families before — a line in the ledger for December 1959 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Belonging to the old families twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ belong on the top shelf year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Belong on the top shelf at once and never mention it again.

By 1972 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the ledger, and a new neighbour from the next pasture ⑧ belongs on the top shelf twice over every winter without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the pen, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ belonged to the old families again when nobody else would.

⑩ To belong to the old families, my mother said in 1977, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the pasture remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the pasture forgets, somebody belongs to the old families year after year again and somebody must belong to the old families twice over all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 属于（一般过去式 belonged to the old families：1965 年牧人头一回这样做，来回两遍）
B. v. 属于（一般现在 belongs to the old families：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 属于（不定式 to belong to the old families：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 属于（过去完成时 had belonged to the old families：1959 年十二月的牧群台账上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 属于（动名词 belonging to the old families 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 该放在（belong on the top shelf：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去该放在架子最上一层）
G. v. 该放在（belong on the top shelf：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 属于（后段两处：新来的邻人照例 belongs on the top shelf，而母亲又一次 belonged to the old families）

items.q: to belong to the old families
belonged to the old families before
belong on the top shelf year after year
belong on the top shelf at once
belongs on the top shelf twice over
belonged to the old families again
to belong to the old families

answers.why: belong 意为“属于”，1965 年牧人来回两遍属于那几个老家族，那是牧场里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 belonged。
belong 意为“属于”，自那以后牧人年年地把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 belongs。
belong 意为“属于”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯属于那几个老家族”，此处为不定式 to belong to the old families。
belong 意为“属于”，牧群台账里 十二月 那行字说明早在 1972 年之前就有人属于过，故用过去完成时 had belonged。
belong 意为“属于”，牧人说“属于那几个老家族这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 belonging to the old families 作主语。
belong 意为“该放在”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去该放在架子最上一层”，should ever 之后用原形 belong on the top shelf。
belong 意为“该放在”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻该放在架子最上一层（belong on the top shelf at once），以后再也不要提起。
belong 意为“属于”，新来的邻人每个冬天都照例该放在架子最上一层，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 belongs。
belong 意为“属于”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次来回两遍属于那几个老家族，用一般过去式 belonged 叙述。
belong 意为“属于”，结尾那句是母亲 1977 年的话：要属于那几个老家族，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和牧场记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年，牧人来回两遍属于那几个老家族；牧场里每一个邻人都说这是头一回。（belonged to the old families）
多年以后，牧人仍年年地做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（belongs to the old families）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯属于那几个老家族这件事本身。（to belong to the old families）
早在 1959 年就有人属于那几个老家族，十二月那天牧群台账上的一行字就是证据。（had belonged to the old families）
牧人说过，来回两遍属于那几个老家族这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（belonging to the old families 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻该放在架子最上一层，以后再也不要提起。（belong on the top shelf，祈使句）
answers: In 1965 the herder belonged to the old families twice over, and every neighbour in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three winters on, the herder still belongs to the old families year after year without being asked.
My mother said later that to belong to the old families at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had belonged to the old families long before 1972, and the line in the ledger for December proves it.
Belonging to the old families twice over, the herder said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Belong on the top shelf at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 belong 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1965 the herder belonged to the old families twice over, and nobody in the pasture forgot it.
Even now the herder belongs to the old families year after year whenever the pasture asks.
Belonging to the old families twice over, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever belong on the top shelf year after year, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new neighbour from the next pasture belongs on the top shelf twice over every winter, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother belonged to the old families again, and the pasture remembered that half.
